title: Terrible design; otherwise tape picks up lint as good as others
text:
Terrible design; otherwise tape picks up lint as good as others. I hate this set of rollers. There are two handles and six rolls. The two handles are installed in two of the rolls and have to be removed once the roll is done to use on the other rolls.

The handles themselves are delicate and I can see the bottom breaking before all the tape is used up.

What I absolutely hate about this set is that it is practically IMPOSSIBLE to remove the label on the roller. I had to remove mine in pieces and had to actually use a scissor to start cutting it off. It took me about 5 minutes to get the label off and it wasted a couple of sheets.  Second, once the label is off, there is nothing to cover the roller for storage.  The Scotch-Brite lint rollers always have a label that can be slapped back on when the roller is not in use. It kept sticking to everything as I have nothing to cover it with. In addition, the handle kept coming apart (see photo). The handle actually has to be seated well within the tube for this not to happen.

I did use the tape and it works very well. It picks up just as good as my favorite brand (Scotch-Brite). I also love that the tape removes on an angle. It is a lot easy to peel off the used tape that way. In this sense, it is actually a better design than my favorite brand.

There are supposedly a total of 120 sheets over 6 rolls, which means there are 20 sheets per roll. This would have gotten 4 stars from me if the label peeled off easily and was used to protect the tape when not in use. As it stands now, I hate this set.
